summary: Connect OECD DAC criteria with intended use, evidence and actionable recommendations. Explore the five-day training outline and assess fit for your team.
lede: OECD DAC criteria and utilisation-focused evaluation help teams design evaluations around clear questions, credible evidence and intended use. For evaluation officers, programme managers and learning specialists, the course addresses connecting criteria to decision needs through theory-of-change and evaluability work, evaluation matrices, and mixed-method evidence planning. Participants also practise tracing evidence into judgements and developing recommendations and use plans for intended users.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who commission, manage, conduct or use programme evaluations and need to connect OECD DAC criteria with clear evaluation questions, defensible findings and defined decision uses.
audience: Public Policy Analysts using evaluation findings
modules: OECD DAC Criteria and Evaluation Logic
prerequisites: Working familiarity with programme design, results frameworks or monitoring and evaluation terminology is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
